name: After § 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for EU support towards a just transition and reconstruction in Syria
part_text: 5a. Is deeply concerned about the situation of Christians in Syria, many of whom were also killed by regime forces in the recent clashes and most notably by foreign fighters with former Al-Qaeda/Daesh backgrounds; emphasises the need to protect all religious minorities in Syria, including the Christian community, guaranteeing their security and the right to remain in their territories of origin and their religious freedom;
